long_biography.plain_text:
After studying organic chemistry at Clemson University, DeNeui worked in financial services and national sales. His entry into preventive medicine came through BioTE Medical, where he was an original owner and helped establish a broad hormone-therapy business. That experience led him to develop standardized care systems, education programs and commercial support for medical practices.

At EVEXIAS, DeNeui partnered with Terri DeNeui in expanding a wider health-services platform, taking responsibility for strategy and scale while she directed clinical work. DeNeui also became CEO and managing partner of a group spanning customized medicines, 503A pharmacies and 503B outsourcing. Under his leadership, it acquired and expanded a Conway, Arkansas, compounding facility. He has also participated in federal discussions about peptide ingredients used by compounding pharmacies.
